q: Can you talk about the last place you visited?
a:
The last place I visited was Gaziantep, which is one of the most famous gastronomic cities in Turkey. I went there with my friends for a short trip two months ago. We stayed in a historic mansion that we booked on Airbnb, and the atmosphere of the house made the experience even more special.

During my visit, I had the chance to try many traditional dishes. I really enjoyed the local cuisine. What impressed me the most was the variety of the food. My favorite dishes were Ali Nazik kebab, lahmacun, and katmer. I also tasted different kinds of baklava, and they were absolutely delicious.
